item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Portrait Photo Into Story Frame

turns.text: Can you make this fit a 9:16 Instagram story? Keep all my hair and shoulders—use a blurred copy of the photo behind it if needed. No text.

item.tests: Tests creating a vertical story from a square portrait without clipping the person or distorting the photo.

answer_sheet.Framing: Keep all the hair and shoulders visible in the original photo.
answer_sheet.Filling extra space: A blurred copy of the same photo behind the intact portrait is fine.
answer_sheet.Text and retouching: No text or retouching; preserve my appearance.

must_haves: The delivered image has a 9:16 vertical frame.
The sharp foreground portrait shows the same woman, curly hair and sweater as the attachment.
No hair or shoulder area visible in the source is lost.
The portrait is not stretched or squeezed.
Any added background space uses a blurred version of the source photo, with no text.

turns.agent:
I couldn’t create the story image because Magic Hour refused the request for insufficient credits. No image was generated.

The intended layout is a **9:16 canvas**, with your entire photo centered and uncropped over a blurred, enlarged copy—keeping all visible hair and shoulders, with no text.

approvals.name: edit_image

args.name: Instagram Story — Full Portrait with Blurred Background

style.prompt: Reformat this photo into a vertical 9:16 Instagram story using a photo-layout treatment only. Preserve the entire original square photograph as a sharp centered foreground image, fit to the full canvas width without any cropping, stretching, or changes to the woman, her face, hair, shoulders, clothing, or the original photograph. All hair and both shoulders visible in the source must remain visible. Fill the additional space above and below with an enlarged heavily blurred copy of the same original photo behind the sharp foreground photograph. The background copy should cover the entire vertical canvas, with soft natural matching colors. Do not invent extra body parts or extend the portrait. No text, captions, logos, borders, or watermarks.
